content.title: Jack Daniel's Parent Brown-Forman Keeps Outlook Steady While Flagging Market Pressures
content.summary: Brown Forman Inc. (NYSE:BF) (NYSE:BF), the parent of Jack Daniel’s whiskey, Old Foster and other popular brands, saw its stock drop Thursday after it reported a weaker-than-expected first-quarter fiscal 2025. The Louisville-based distiller reported first-quarter earnings per share of 36 cents, missing the analyst consensus estimate of 37 cents.
